messages:
Mira (Sales): FYI customer asks to sign redlines today — MFN + 12mo price protection + asks to cap discounts at 20%. We need quick alignment, POC starts next week.
Leo (Legal): Can you paste the exact snippet? MFN + price protection can limit our promo flexibility and screw future commits. :eyes:
Mira (Sales): ```
Section 3.1 MFN: Customer shall receive pricing no less favorable than any other customer for equivalent volumes.
Section 3.2 Price Protection: Redwood shall not increase per-unit pricing for 12 months after Effective Date.
Section 3.3 Discount Cap: Total discounts shall not exceed 20% off list.
```
Ash (AE): Deal context — if they commit 12 months we’re at ~$2.1M ARR. POC is 3 weeks (8 GPUs) and they want that included in the MFN window.
Sam (Engineering): For the POC we can carve out ephemeral capacity, but cost > baseline if they expect reserved throughput. Need to know if POC pricing counts as "pricing" under MFN. If yes, risky.
Leo (Legal): Recommended route: accept price protection for 12 months but carve out two things: (1) promotional/short-term public discounts \u003c=30 days, (2) separate POC pricing not counted as precedent for MFN. Draft language below.
Marco (Presales): Also call out Dedicated vs Hosted: if they buy Dedicated commit, rate card differs. MFN should be scoped to the product family (Hosted API vs Dedicated). Otherwise we lock all variants.
Leo (Legal): Proposed redline to suggest to customer: 
```
MFN carveouts: MFN and price protection apply only to standard list rates for the specific Product Family purchased by Customer (e.g., Hosted API or Dedicated capacity). Promotional discounts lasting 30 days or less, trial/POC pricing offered for evaluation, and public marketplace promotions are excluded from MFN. Price increases for additional feature tiers are not covered.
```
Mira (Sales): That looks reasonable. Can deal desk pre-approve up to 18% discount for POC/intro? If we require 12mo commit to get the 18% this protects us.
dealbot: Deal Desk request created: DD-9876 — special discount approval (>15%) + MFN carveout confirmation. Routing to Director Sales.
Ash (AE): +1 to carveouts. We should also add a sunset on MFN tied to renewal negotiation: MFN covers 12 months but should not auto-extend across renewal unless we explicitly agree.
Leo (Legal): Add sentence: "MFN protections expire at the end of the 12-month period and do not automatically renew unless mutually agreed in writing."
Sam (Engineering): Action item — I’ll run the cost model for the 3-week POC + estimate incremental GPU hours if we guarantee latency SLOs. Need numbers by EOD tomorrow.
Marco (Presales): I can provision a limited POC config that mirrors production perf but with capacity guardrails. Will share runbook for the customer.
Mira (Sales): Action list recap: (1) Leo: finalize redline with carveouts + non-auto-renew language by tomorrow AM; (2) Deal Desk (DD-9876): pre-approve up to 18% for POC tied to 12mo commit; (3) Sam: cost run for POC; (4) Marco: POC runbook and resource check.
Ash (AE): Noted. If Deal Desk denies >15% we’ll propose a staggered discount: 15% first 3 months, then back to 10% for remainder.
dealbot: Status update: DD-9876 escalated to Sales Director for >15% approvals. ETA 24h.
Mira (Sales): Thanks all — I’ll brief the customer once Leo has the revised language. Please ping here with any blockers. :thumbsup:
